# Meadowlark Dental — Portfolio Company (Healthcare Services)

- **What it is:** a dental-services organization (DSO) roll-up; SCP acquired the platform in 2020.
  **42 locations**, ~**$19M EBITDA**.
- **Metrics:** current gross **MOIC 2.4x**, gross IRR ~24%.
- **Board:** [Kate Sinclair](../profile/principal.md) sits on the board; add-on engine run by
  [Rebecca Cho](../people/rebecca-cho.md).
- **Strategy:** heavy **add-on** cadence — acquiring individual and small-group practices and
  onboarding them to the platform.
- **Status:** **performing; add-on heavy.** Integration capacity is the constraint on pace.

## Open items
- De-novo vs. acquired-location mix decision for 2027 planning (early).
